en.title: Mireye (YC S26) – Infrastructure for Physical World AI Agents
en.hook: An infrastructure platform built to simplify developing and deploying AI agents operating in the physical world.
key_takeaways: Dedicated infrastructure platform for physical and embodied AI agents.
Simplifies sensor integration, spatial perception, and execution loops.
YC S26 startup aiming to accelerate real-world AI agent commercialization.
